<tspan x="815.0" dy="0">Bottom-to-top; independent outputs are parallel, never an implicit tensor chain</tspan>

</text>

<tspan x="815.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>

<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="815.0" y="847" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">

</text>
